transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Thank you for taking the time to see me. I hope I'm not wasting your time today. Um... I'm here because... well, my family kind of pushed for it. I really don't want to come across like I'm a difficult person or making trouble, you know? I'm a pretty easygoing guy. 

It's just... everybody keeps acting like I'm imagining things. But I'm a fabricator. I work with my hands for a living, and I know exactly where I leave my things. My tools don't just move themselves. I know my wife's relative came into this house to get at me. And it's not just the tools... every weekend, my fishing plans get spoiled, and I know it's not by accident. 

I've tried to be patient about it, I really have. But after all these months, I can see plain as day that he's been trying to take over my place and push me out. Does that... does that make sense why I'd be upset about that? I just want to make sure I'm explaining it right.
Aside from these experiences with your tools and your fishing plans, have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people around you couldn't hear or see?

Oh, no, Dr. Smith. No, nothing like that at all. I... I know how all this must sound, with me being so worked up about the tools and the garage, but I promise you my mind is perfectly sound. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there, I swear. 

I'm just a regular, hardworking guy noticing real things happening in my own home. I hope you believe me on that. I really wouldn't want you to think I'm... well, you know, losing my grip or making things up. That's not me at all, I've always been very level-headed. Is it okay that I just want to make sure we're on the same page about that? I just really want to make a good impression here.
Are there any other people, besides your wife's relative, whom you believe are involved in these actions against you?

Oh, no. No, definitely not. I... I really want to be clear about that, because I don't want to sound like one of those guys who thinks everyone in the world is out to get him. That's not me at all. 

I get along great with my neighbors, the guys at the shop... everyone else, really. I've always been a real team player, you know? It's just this one specific situation with him. Just him. I hope that helps you see that I'm trying to be really objective about this. I'm not pointing fingers at random people, I'm just looking at the facts of what's happening in my own house. Does that... does that show I'm being reasonable about all this? I just really want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture of who I am.
Have you ever felt suspicious that your wife might be involved in any of these plans or that she is being unfaithful to you?

Oh, no. No, my wife? No, she's... she's a wonderful woman. We've been married for a long time. I... I really don't want to give you the wrong idea about our marriage. We're very happy together. 

I don't think she's involved at all. I mean, it's her relative, so I think she just kind of... turns a blind eye to it, maybe? Or she just doesn't want to see what he's doing because they're family. But unfaithful? Oh, no, nothing like that. I would never think that of her. I'm a very trusting husband, really. I just... I just think she's caught in the middle of a bad situation, you know? 

I hope that doesn't make me sound like I'm criticizing her. I really try to be understanding of her position. Is it okay that I see it that way? I just want to make sure I'm being fair to everyone involved.
Have you ever tried to confront this relative or point out the specific evidence of his actions to him directly?

Well, um... no. No, I haven't actually said anything to him directly about it. I... I really try to avoid conflict, you know? I'm not the kind of guy who goes around starting arguments or causing a big scene, especially since it's family. I'd hate to put my wife in an awkward spot like that. 

I just... I figure it's better to just keep my head down and quietly reorganize my tools or fix whatever he messes with in the garage. I hope you don't think I'm being a pushover or a coward by not confronting him. I just really believe in keeping the peace and trying to be the bigger person. 

Does that... does that seem like the right way to handle it to you? I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing. I'd really hate for you to think I'm hot-headed or looking for trouble, because I'm honestly just trying to keep things calm for everyone.
Have you ever felt like your own thoughts or your own actions were being controlled or influenced by someone else?

Oh, no, no. Definitely not. I... I know some people struggle with things like that, but I've never felt anything like that at all. My thoughts are completely my own, and I make my own decisions. 

I'm a very grounded person, you know? I go to work, I do my job, I come home... I'm just a regular guy. I really wouldn't want you to think I'm losing my grip on reality or anything like that, because I'm not. I'm just dealing with this one very specific, very real problem with my tools and my garage. 

I hope it's okay that I'm being so firm about that. I just really want to make sure I'm giving you the right impression of how I'm doing mentally. I'm completely in control of myself. Does that... does that make sense? I just want to be helpful and give you the right answers.
Has this situation with your tools and your garage caused you to miss any work or impacted your ability to perform your job effectively?

Oh, no, no, not at all. I haven't missed any work. I... I really pride myself on being dependable, you know? I still get up every single morning, go down to the plant, and do my work as an assembler just like I always have. I make sure the bills are paid and I take care of myself. 

I'd hate for you to think this is ruining my life or that I'm falling apart, because I'm really not. I'm keeping everything together. I'm a hard worker. The... the trouble is really just all centered on what's happening right there in my house, with him and my things in the garage. 

I hope that shows you that I'm still functioning perfectly fine. I just want to make sure you see that I'm handling my responsibilities. Is it... is it a good sign that I'm still working every day? I just want to make sure I'm doing as well as I think I am.
How long have you been noticing these specific things happening with your tools and your fishing plans?

Well, um... let's see. It's been about nine months now. It started right around the time my wife's relative needed a place to stay and moved into our home. I... I really don't want to sound like I'm complaining about him living with us, because family is family, and you have to help out when you can, right? I'd hate for you to think I'm ungracious or holding a grudge about him being under our roof. 

It's just that I started noticing the tools being messed with and the, um, interference with my fishing plans right after he got settled in. I hope it doesn't make me sound petty or obsessive for keeping track of the timeline like that. Nine months really isn't that long in the grand scheme of things, anyway. I just try to be observant. Is it... is it helpful that I remember exactly when it started? I just want to give you the most accurate timeline I can so I'm doing this right.
